messages.author: 36fffaa82438da6f
messages.subject: R/shiny folder installation admin rights
parts:
Hi, I've recently installed R and RStudio because I want to create a dashboard that make it easier my job and also that looks amazing. But I have a problem, I have no administrator rights in my work, so I have problems when I want to install a package as Shiny. I couldn't make my user as administrator, but I could ask for administrator rights in a folder. Could you tell me please, what folder(s) do I need to have admin rights in order to be able of install R packages?
Thanks in advance!

Jorge.

PD. I'm sorry for my English.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: R/shiny folder installation admin rights
parts:
If you have R installed, you shouldn't need admin rights to install the Shiny package itself--R's default behavior when you install libraries as a non-administrator, is to create a personal library folder for you.

If you want to install the Shiny Server software package, which is only available for Linux and is required for hosting Shiny apps for production, then you'll need an administrator to perform the installation for you.

messages.subject: Re: R/shiny folder installation admin rights
parts:
(English tip: you should say "I have another question", not "I have another doubt")

It depends entirely on what you want your dashboard to do. If you want your dashboard to read from a MySQL database, you'll need RMySQL. If you want to plot using ggplot2, you'll need ggplot2. It's just like any other R code--depending on what you want to accomplish, you may need other packages to get there.
